title: Fullscreen target shared container
trigger: Multiple UI pieces must remain visible together in fullscreen but the browser API fullscreens only one element.
principle: When sibling UI must stay visible in fullscreen, the fullscreen element must be their common ancestor, not the media element. If you can't control the fullscreen target (CSP + isolated world + user gesture constraints), move your UI into the fullscreen element as a flex sibling or fixed overlay instead of trying to redirect the target.

cases.context: Player fullscreen button targets the video element — sibling subtitle panel disappears because it's outside the fullscreen layer
Fullscreen element is a bare <video> that can't host rendered siblings — need fallback
cases.bad:
// Assume fullscreen element is always a container
fullscreenEl.appendChild(panel); // <video> can't render sibling divs → panel invisible

applyFor: Video players with side panels (subtitle, playlist, chat, annotations)
Media players where controls/overlays must stay beside the video in fullscreen
Content scripts that inject sibling UI into a site's native player
Any fullscreen transition where the browser API targets a child but a sibling must remain visible
